As per clause 5.1(2) of the Revised Procedure, any action including revocation of Stage-II connectivity or encashment of BG initiated after the issuance of the Revised Procedure shall be in accordance with the provisions thereof. _(1) Any action already initiated for revocation of Stage-II Connectivity or encashment of Bank Guarantee prior to the issue of this Procedure shall be completed under the Prerevised Procedure._ _(2) Any action including revocation of Stage-II Connectivity or encashment of Bank Guarantee initiated after the issue of this Procedure shall be in accordance with this Procedure._
